verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that LangSmith's client SDK is published on GitHub (langsmith-sdk) and that an official MCP server repo exists. Neither item states a license, and nothing indicates the core platform's source is open. Self-hosting is documented, but that is not the same as open source, and community comments point to a cloud-account dependency. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core LangSmith platform, an explicit OSI-approved license for any repo, and independent confirmation of source openness.
